content.text: Pending response to code review comments.
The following comments still need to be addressed:
, are you still working on this ticket?
If not, I can wrap this one up.
I am OK with it. thanks,
I did this work over the Christmas break, and haven't been able to get back to it since.  I'll revisit to see what needs to be done beyond a rebase and a PR.
.  I believe it addresses all of the remaining issues, and is properly rebased and happy.  Due to the disjointed nature of my work on this one, I may have missed something.
Pending one extremely minor code review comment, this looks good to go.

HTTP spec says that strong eTags should be based on the byte-for-byte serialization of the response that's sent, and LDP wants to use it for checking if the state has changed. We currently use strong e-tags, but not correctly (it doesn't change with different serializations) - we should just be able to prepend "W/".
